risk_summary: The disclosure is generally quantitative and explains the major drivers of the 2018 revenue decline, margin compression, and sharp SG&A increase. Risk is elevated by reduced military retrofit demand, nonreplacement of completed EDC programs, adverse economic sensitivity, valuation allowances, and inventory-obsolescence judgments, although management presents retrofit opportunities and generally controlled tax and accrual exposures.
